description: Send an immediate reply to a message (linking it into that thread). fmsg messages are immutable: once sent they cannot be edited or recalled. Send within the user's requested task or authorized automation. By default the reply goes to everyone on the parent message — its sender, recipients and anyone added later — except you; pass recipients to narrow or widen that. Fails if the parent is terminal (no replies possible); a parent marked no-reply is refused unless allow_no_reply is true. Secrets are redacted. Files: data_text for text, data_base64 for small files; add sha256 when you can. Send files as they are; fmsg compresses them.

allow_no_reply.description: reply even though the parent asked for no replies

content_type.description: inferred from the filename when omitted

data_base64.description: base64 file contents, for small files. The host sets the size limit

data_text.description: text file contents, sent as UTF-8 bytes; use instead of data_base64 for text

sha256.description: hex sha256 of the file; the attachment is refused, and nothing sent, if the bytes differ. Give it when you can compute it

body.description: reply body; Markdown unless type says otherwise

no_reply.description: ask recipients (and their agents) not to reply

name: reply

attachments.description: sorted by filename, the same order in every tool

type.description: media type; inferred from the filename when the host records none

hint.description: for you, not the user: a better way to do this next time

redacted.description: the kinds of secret replaced, such as github_token; empty when none

redactions.description: secrets replaced with placeholders before sending

resolved.description: short names and how they resolved, when any were given; confirm with the user if an address looks wrong

thread_topic.description: the thread's topic: the topic sent for a new message; for a reply, the thread root's topic, or null when the root is not visible

warnings.description: things to tell the user, such as redacted secrets or resolved short names

title: Reply in fmsg thread
